charts.title: TOI-700 e: orbits around TOI-700
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-700's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-700 e highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Pass et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172..175P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PASS_ET_AL_2026): P 27.810124 d

charts.title: TOI-700 e: its transit
charts.description: TOI-700 e crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (95, 96, 97) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 150428135, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 12-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 12-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
